I have been farming this land in Quzhou for 53 years. I am 63 now, and I know every plot. My family has six people, but some of the younger ones work in the county town, so I cannot take on too much labor myself. I have 20 mu and a well for irrigation, which means I can water when I need to, but I must be careful with electricity costs.

This is how I will manage my crops this year.

**Wheat:** I plant 7 mu of winter wheat. It is already in the ground from last autumn. I always use improved seed — I buy it from the supply shop because it gives me stable yields. I will rotary till before planting, as I always do. For fertilizer, I will put down about 28 kg of nitrogen per mu. I do not bother much with phosphorus or potash; the soil here has enough, and compound fertilizer gives a little anyway. I will irrigate four times: the green-up water in spring, then at jointing, heading, and grain-filling. That is what my father taught me, and it still works. I spray pesticides four times when I see aphids or rust. I expect about 500 kg per mu if the weather is normal.

**Maize:** After I harvest the wheat in early June, I will plant 7 mu of maize immediately on the same land. I use hybrid seed for maize — it costs more, but the yield is much better. I do not till for maize; I plant no-tillage directly into the wheat stubble with the machine. Time is short between wheat harvest and maize planting, and I am not as young as I used to be. I only add a little nitrogen, about 2 kg per mu, because the wheat field already has fertility left. I irrigate twice — once after planting if it is dry, and once at the big flare stage. Three pesticide sprays are enough for maize. I expect around 530 kg per mu.

**Cotton:** I keep 6 mu for cotton. Cotton is my main cash crop, but it takes a lot of work. I use improved cotton seed. I rotary till the cotton field in spring to warm the soil. I apply about 4 kg of nitrogen per mu and a little phosphorus, about 1 kg per mu. I irrigate twice — once after sowing to help emergence, and once during flowering. The biggest problem with cotton is insects. I will spray pesticide 16 times through the season. I know it is a lot, but if I skip even one spray, the bollworms will destroy everything. I expect about 275 kg of seed cotton per mu.
